primitives.name: Task Status Transition Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Update STATUS in this file as you go: `TODO` -> `DOING` -> `DONE` | `BLOCKED`.
primitives.assumptions: Sequential task execution with deterministic state progression.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When STRIKES = 2, task is BLOCKED and must be skipped.

layer2.mapping: State transition function maps task progress through discrete stages with failure counter.
layer2.telemetry: Commit log integrity and task completion timestamp.

primitives.name: Git Commit Authorship Consistency Check
primitives.verbatim_quote: `git config user.name` in this repo is literally `Codex <codex@openai.local>`, so EVERY commit made from this machine is stamped "Codex" regardless of which model or human authored it.
primitives.assumptions: Single machine authorship with unified commit stamping.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Inference of multiple agents from commit author split is invalid.

layer2.mapping: Commit metadata validation kernel filters spurious agent claims.
layer2.telemetry: Git log author field consistency over time windows.

primitives.name: Task Priority Override Mechanism
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Skip to `P7-01` next if you are choosing what to work on** — it rescues P4-05's genuinely stranded security fix, and the linear top-to-bottom rule has kept it buried behind unrelated TODOs for a full day.
primitives.assumptions: Linear task ordering with explicit override rules.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Override applies when task P7-01 is unblocked and P4-05 is stranded.

layer2.mapping: Priority nudging operator shifts task selection based on embedded urgency signals.
layer2.telemetry: Task selection frequency and delay from top-down scheduling.
